full_prompt_en: A square pop-art photographic print presents a tight head-and-shoulders view of a pale-haired young man against a distressed magenta background. He faces nearly forward, looking slightly past the viewer with a reserved, intense expression. Straight light hair sweeps across his forehead and partly shades one eye. His left side is buried in deep black shadow, while the other side of his face is modeled in silvery gray with patches of vivid yellow on the nose and cheek and scattered pink and blue marks across the skin. A hand rises in front of his chin, two fingers holding a short white cigarette with a yellow filter near his lips. He wears a dark jacket over a bright yellow shirt and narrow dark tie. The crop brings his face close to the upper edge and cuts off the lower chest, making the gaze and hand the central events. The magenta ground shows rough scratches, uneven ink coverage, and faint rectangular traces rather than a seamless studio color. The portrait itself has visible photographic grain, hard black contours, and irregular areas of overprinted color. Yellow, pink, and cyan do not align perfectly with the gray face, producing a tactile screenprint effect. Light is dramatic but mostly carried by the source photograph's contrast; the later color overlays transform rather than replace its modeling. The visual balance is forceful: a near-black left side, pale hair at the top, a sharp yellow diagonal at the collar, and hot pink around the silhouette. The mood is cool, confrontational, and fashionably artificial, as if a candid photograph had been turned into a worn street poster.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形波普艺术摄影印刷品近距离呈现一名浅发年轻男子的头肩，背后是磨损的洋红色背景。他几乎正面朝向相机，视线略越过观者，表情克制而强烈。浅色直发扫过前额，局部遮住一只眼。他的左半脸埋在浓黑阴影里，另一侧由银灰塑形，鼻和颊有鲜明黄色斑块，皮肤上散落粉色与蓝色印迹。一只手在下巴前抬起，两指夹着短白烟，黄色滤嘴靠近嘴唇。他穿深色外套，里面是明亮黄衬衫与窄深色领带。裁切使面孔贴近上边缘，下方胸部被截断，让目光和手成为中央事件。洋红色底面可见粗刮痕、浓淡不匀的油墨与微弱矩形痕，而非无缝影棚色。肖像本身有明显摄影颗粒、硬黑轮廓和不规则套印色域。黄、粉、青与灰色面孔没有完全对齐，产生可触的丝网印刷效果。光照强烈，却主要由原照片反差承载；后加颜色转换了塑形，而非取代塑形。视觉平衡有力：左半边近黑、上方浅发、领口一道鲜明黄斜线，以及剪影四周炽热洋红色。氛围冷峻、正面且时髦地人工化，像一张抓拍照片被转制成磨旧街头海报。
style_prompt_en: Pop-art photographic printmaking starts with a grainy, high-contrast monochrome image and lays imperfectly registered fields of saturated magenta, yellow, cyan, and red across it. Deep blacks retain the original structure while color blocks interrupt realistic skin, fabric, and background. Scratches, ink gaps, visible halftone-like grain, and rough overprinting keep the surface worn and tactile. A tight crop intensifies one gaze or gesture; strong shadow can divide the central form into a nearly black half and a bright, color-struck half. Flat saturated ground does not need spatial depth, but faint printed seams and abrasions can prevent it from feeling sterile. The style is bold, graphic, and slightly abrasive, balancing a recognizable photographic source with deliberate color misalignment and poster-like directness.
style_prompt_zh: 波普艺术摄影印刷从颗粒明显、高反差的黑白图像出发，再把套位略错的饱和洋红、黄、青与红色域叠印其上。深黑保留原图结构，色块则打断写实的肤面、衣料与背景。刮痕、漏墨、类似半色调的可见颗粒与粗糙套印，让表面磨损且可触。紧裁切强化一道目光或动作；强阴影可把中央形体分成近黑半边与被明色击中的半边。平涂饱和背景无须空间纵深，微弱印刷接缝与磨痕却能避免洁净僵硬。风格大胆、图形化且略显粗砺，在可辨摄影来源与刻意错位色彩、海报般直接表达之间求得平衡。
theme_en: A pale-haired man holds a cigarette against a magenta print field
theme_zh: 浅发男子在洋红色印刷背景前夹着一支香烟
name: Andy Warhol
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
